question: On identical saved joint variable-cell frozen-bias objectives and, separately, on identical saved structures for unbiased cell relaxation, do Safe-total, ASE LBFGSLineSearch, or SciPy L-BFGS-B reach the relevant common certificate at lower paid E/F/stress cost?

budget.stop: No retries. Preserve backend/SCF failures, request/wall-censored endpoints, and all request costs. This first panel is frozen-objective and numerical-certificate qualification, not an independent optimizer ranking.
budget.execution: 12 independent processes: 2 materials x 3 optimizers x 2 fixed tasks; one shared V100 allocation, sequential. Each process validates its saved physical objective once, then at most 600 search and one fresh endpoint request. An in-flight killed evaluation is reported separately from completed ledger entries.

common_contract.biased_stop: max(max_i ||g_atom_i||_2, ||g_cell_6||_2) <= 0.05 eV/A on an accepted iterate; this is the new panel threshold, not the source run's 0.005 threshold
common_contract.unbiased_physical_certificate: max(fmax/fmax_limit, max_abs(stress + pressure I)/stress_limit) <= 1 on an accepted iterate
common_contract.accepted_telemetry: Record paid request index, volume, raw physical fmax and pressure-residual stress, biased common gradient norm, and unbiased physical certificate at every accepted iterate; report first qualifying accepted request and complete native termination cost separately. From the biased accepted trace, report first passages at 0.1 and 0.05 eV/A; Safe uses the common biased criterion to stop, while SciPy/ASE retain native stops and are read offline. No added PES evaluations for trace observation.
common_contract.unbiased_stop_and_readout: Safe-total stops on the common physical certificate with fmax=0.05 eV/A and stress_tol=0.001 eV/A^3. SciPy and ASE retain native q-gradient/force stopping (native scale derived from the new panel 0.05 eV/A tolerance using the VC norm-contract conversions), and their first accepted physical certificate crossing is reported offline alongside full native termination cost. The physical certificate value 1 is never passed as a gradient tolerance.
common_contract.unbiased_task_start: For each material, every optimizer starts unbiased cell relaxation from the exact same archived post-bias q_saved. It is an independent fixed task and does not start from each method's biased endpoint, so this panel isolates the no-bias cell-relax comparison. Chained biased-endpoint quenches are deferred.
common_contract.implementation_scope: Full numerical implementation comparison, not an isolated line-search ablation. Reuse existing Safe-total and research ASE/SciPy adapters. Retain Safe joint step cap, ASE triplet step cap, SciPy defaults, and each backend native termination; report native stop and common certificate independently. Accepted trace points must be cache hits; cache misses are errors and never trigger hidden evaluations.
